review_description: Provided quote within intwo days, all quotes were given the same specs.Instalation of panels excellent, but a little tardy with final connection

Sales & quoting process was quick & easy considering we live on far south coastInstallation was neat, tidy & on timeThe customer service was excellent, captain kilowatt took care of everything on our behalf

We were very very pleased with the quote, the service and the installation.  Our electrician looked at the system and said it was well installed, and even the guy from ACTEW / EVO energy who came to hook it into the mains came promptly because he said it was always a pleasure doing business with the Capt Kilowatt installers. It has been running for about a year, and we are very happy with the advice and system they provided.

Following an email to Captain Kilowatt, it was no time before a lovely guy (Mark) got in touch and made the time to travel to our place (near Harden) and provide a quote. It is difficult to get tradespeople to come to our area, especially Canberra tradespeople.The team was efficient, quick, thorough and worked very well together. The attention to detail was especially good - no masses of conduit all over our brick walls. The team took the time to explain how to operate the system and were able to answer any queries we had. Well done. We hope you enjoyed your pizza!

Got a solar pre-write done.The guys were on time and had it all done in 1.5 hours at short notice and a competitive price. Andy from friendly and helpful.I needed a quick pre-wire because the house has high ceilings and it was going to be difficult to do the wiring when it is all sheeted.

It is pathetic how I have been lied to over and over again that someone would be coming out to fix it and we are part of the Captain Kilowatt family.
